title: Guest types
description: Kinds of guests that visit the venue (/data/guest_types.json). Which types appear where, and how often, is set per venue in venues.json.

patience_seconds.description: How long the table waits for service before its mood starts dropping.

spending_power.description: Multiplier on menu prices for this guest's orders.

tip_rate.description: Bakšiš as a fraction of the bill at neutral table mood (see economy.tips.mood_curve).

party_size.description: Number of guests in the group. A group always occupies exactly one table.

stay_seconds.description: How long a satisfied table stays before paying and leaving.

orders_per_visit.description: Rounds ordered per visit (each round = one item per guest).

song_request_interval_seconds.description: Average time between song requests from this table.

mood_sensitivity.description: Multiplier on all mood changes for this table (song matches, mismatches, waiting).
